description: Registered arrange-auto layout optimizers (Wave 2, fork 3). `ley parcel arrange auto` asks the ACTIVE optimizer (or `--strategy <id>`) to choose a NO-HOLE partition for the target display's windows; the chosen {orient, parts} is lowered by lib/jq/arrange.jq through the canonical AR::bridge_arrangement (no forked geometry). The registry mirrors tiling_strategies — a future optimizer is a sibling .jq + an entry + `ley parcel arrange optimizer use <id>`, a MANIFEST edit not a code edit. Unlike the tiling strategy (which the reactor runs each settle), an optimizer switch affects only the NEXT arrange gesture, so the change_event is emitted-but-unsubscribed (observability only). v1 `aspect` minimizes the minimax aspect-ratio distortion max|log(cell_AR) - log(display_AR)| over the justified-rows + column-transpose candidate family — OPTIMAL WITHIN THAT FAMILY, not globally (the family is a strict subset of all no-hole tilings). Each entry's `module` is a PURE jq program under parcel/arrange-optimizers/ (zero read-only-lens imports) exposing `choose($w; $display_frame; $config)`. `config` is the per-optimizer knob block (v1 reads none).
